create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss criterion to compute weighted mean absolute error between predictions and targets
create_L2Loss: create an L2Loss criterion to compute weighted mean squared error between predictions and targets
create_MSELoss: create an MSELoss criterion to compute mean squared error between predictions and targets
create_BCELoss: create a BCELoss criterion to compute binary cross entropy with optional weight between predictions and targets
create_BCEWithLogitsLoss: create a BCEWithLogitsLoss criterion to compute binary cross entropy with logits and optional weight
